I apologize for the incomplete response earlier. To configure comments in a Django project, you can follow these steps: ```python # settings.py INSTALLED_APPS = [ # ... 'comments.apps.CommentsConfig', ] # models.py from django.db import models class Comment(models.Model): text = models.CharField(max_length=255) timestamp = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True) def __str__(self): return self.text ``` In this example, we have a `Comment` model that represents individual comments. We define two fields: `text` and `timestamp`. The `timestamp` field is an automatic field that gets updated when the comment is created. ```python # views.py from django.shortcuts import render, redirect from .models import Comment def create_comment(request): if request.method == 'POST': text = request.POST.get('text') timestamp = datetime.now() comment = Comment(text=text, timestamp=timestamp) comment.save() return redirect('comments_list') else: return render(request, 'create_comment.html') def comments_list(request): comments = Comment.objects.all() return render(request, 'comments_list.html', {'comments': comments}) ``` In this example, we have two views: `create_comment` and `comments_list`. The `create_comment` view handles the creation of new comments, while the `comments_list` view displays a list of all existing comments. ```html
{% csrf_token %}

Comments List

    {% for comment in comments %}
  • {{ comment.text }} ({{ comment.timestamp }}) Edit Delete
    • {% endfor %}
{% csrf_token %}
{% csrf_token %}
``` In this example, we have four templates: `create_comment`, `comments_list`, `edit_comment`, and `delete_comment`. The `create_comment` template allows users to create new comments, while the `comments_list` template displays a list of all existing comments. The `edit_comment` and `delete_comment` templates allow users to edit or delete individual comments. Please note that this is just one possible way to configure comments in a Django project. Depending on your specific requirements, you may need to modify or extend this example.
